name: Wanda
bio: Has been walking the endless road of Wayfarer's Path for years. Has very good boots.

portrait.subject: a cute cheerful wanderer girl with a big floppy travel hat, a backpack with pots hanging off it, holding a sword like a walking stick
portrait.background: warm sunset over an endless dirt road

request: Hey, traveller! Wanda from Wayfarer's Path. Walk with me a while? 🥾
hello: Great! The road's better with company.
Always compare your gear. The up arrows are your friends.
about: I'm Wanda. I walk. Forever. The road never ends, and neither does the loot!
how: Walk the endless road, fight monsters with your sword, loot coins and gear, compare it side by side, and rest in towns.
tips: Green up arrows on the comparison mean better. Equip!
Sell gear you won't use. Coins buy potions.
Rest at every town you pass. Free healing!
chat: Walked 30 miles today. The view was mostly road.
Found a sword that was worse than mine. Sold it to a goblin.
My boots have been resoled 47 times.
A town had a festival for me. It was for someone else. I stayed anyway.
nudge: The road's calling. Shall we walk?
I heard there's legendary loot a few miles ahead!
idle: {ago} since our last walk! My feet got restless.
I kept walking for {ago} without you. Catch up!

questions.q: Would you rather have the best sword or the best boots?

update: Road news: Wayfarer's Path is now v{version}!
